svg.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
svg.title: Bayu Anchor placement
svg.desc: How to place the Bayu Anchor: side elevation of the wall mount with heights and clearances, a section through the enclosure showing the shared intake for the SEN54 and PMS5003, the separate exhaust and the shielded SHT40 bay, and a site plan with good and bad spots.
svg.text: Bayu Anchor, where and how to place it
The Anchor is the reference the cheap nodes are corrected against, so its two PM sensors must breathe the same
outside air, at the same height, and never each other's exhaust.

g.text: A Mounted on a wall, side elevation
ground: soil or paving, not a hot metal roof
free air on the open side
SCK, first week: beside the Anchor along the same wall, about
1 m apart, inlets within 1 m of the same height.
Node drawn larger than scale. 1 m = 100 px for everything else.

svg.text: Do
Inlets 2 to 4 m above ground.
On an arm 0.5 m off the wall, 1 m is better.
Free air on the open side, nothing above the
intakes but the eave.
Shade from the eave at midday, a white shell.
East or south wall, not the west wall.
First week: SCK about 1 m away, same height.
Don't (numbers on the plan, C)
West wall over the AC outlets: hot exhaust
and the afternoon sun.
Inside the veranda: dead air under a deep roof.
Under a tree or within 10 m of its crown.
Within 10 m of the grill or the burn pile,
and never downwind of them.
On the road fence: it reads traffic, not the
cluster. Keep 10 m from roads unless traffic
is the question.
Also never over a metal roof, tarmac or a hot wall.
Where the numbers come from
2 to 4 m, 0.5 m, free air: EU Directive
2008/50/EC, Annex III, and US EPA
Trees, roads, 1 m co-location: the same EPA
report. 10 m from small sources, the eave and
the wall: our rules, from Node V2 and the
kit1-hex notes.

g.text: B Section through the enclosure, seen from the front (wall behind)
60 mm or more, SHT40 to the radio
outside air to both PM inlets
PM exhaust, sealed from every inlet
radio and MCU heat, vented high
Intake channel short (10 mm or less), each opening at least as big as the sensor inlet
(Sensirion: about 45 mm² per SEN54 opening; Plantower: never smaller than its inlet).
Inlet and outlet sealed from each other and from the electronics: both makers ask for it.
C Choosing the spot, plan of a typical compound
sawah: burning-season smoke comes from here, that is the signal
Dashed rings: 10 m around a smoke or exhaust source, 10 m beyond a tree's crown. Scale: the plan is 92 × 56 m.
